_comment_AzureAdCiamMaui: Public-client (native) app registration in the same Entra External ID (CIAM) tenant as AzureAdCiam (Server) / AzureAdCiam (Web) — a mobile/desktop app cannot use either of those (they're a confidential Web API client and a SPA client respectively). ClientId must also be registered as the app's redirect URI in Azure: on Android as 'msal{ClientId}://auth' (see Platforms/Android/AndroidManifest.xml, which must be updated with the same ClientId), on iOS/MacCatalyst as 'msauth.com.geoassets.app://auth' (matches ApplicationId above, already wired into Platforms/iOS and Platforms/MacCatalyst's Info.plist).

GeoAssetsServer._comment: BaseUrl is required (Identity authorization + Service Order workflow, XD01-24) — local dev default below points at GeoAssets.Server run locally. ApiScope is optional; leave blank to sign in with only the default OIDC scopes.
